fullDescription: A high-performance, dark-themed AI job assistant dashboard. Features a sophisticated aesthetic using glassmorphism, deep charcoal backgrounds (#050505), and vibrant indigo-to-purple gradients (#6366F1 to #A855F7). The interface is designed for HRTech, SaaS platforms, and professional productivity tools, emphasizing a split-pane layout (35/65) for real-time monitoring and deep-dive analysis. Typography combines the modern 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for UI elements with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data, creating a 'tech-native' feel. Key design elements include micro-interactions on hover, custom scrollbars, and high-contrast resume preview components.

structured.summary: A professional AI-driven recruitment monitor and resume optimization dashboard. The design uses a 35/65 split-screen layout where the left panel tracks job flows and the right panel provides deep AI analysis and resume previewing, all wrapped in a premium dark glassmorphism style.

style.description: Modern dark mode aesthetic featuring glassmorphism and gradient accents. Typography uses 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (300-700) for primary text and 'JetBrains Mono' (400-500) for status badges and mono data. Primary colors are deep black (#050505), slate gray (#E2E8F0), and an AI accent gradient from indigo (#6366F1) to purple (#A855F7). Layout utilizes a custom scrollbar (#2D3748) and subtle borders (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)).
style.prompt: Create a UI with a primary background of #050505 and secondary backgrounds of #09090B. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' as the main font family. Implement glassmorphism for cards using background: rgba(17, 19, 23, 1) and border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). On hover, cards should transition to border-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4) over 0.2s. Define an 'ai-gradient' for text and backgrounds using linear-gradient(135deg, #6366F1 0%, #A855F7 100%). Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data and status badges. Custom scrollbars should be 6px wide with a #2D3748 thumb and transparent track.

layout_and_structure.description: A top-down header followed by a vertical split-pane. The left pane (35% width) handles navigation and list items, while the right pane (65% width) handles detailed content, configuration, and previews.

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Create a fixed top navigation bar with a subtle bottom border (white/5%). Items should have a default color of gray-400, changing to white with an indigo glow effect when active. Include a logo area and right-side user profile/notifications.

Design a 35% width sidebar with a right border (white/5%). Include a header section with a Title (24px, Bold), subtitle (14px, gray-400), and a button group for 'Filter' and 'Sort' using bg-white/5. The content area should be a scrollable list of glass-style cards.

Design a 65% width main content area with background #09090B. The top features a configuration panel for website settings. Below this, include a tabbed navigation (JD Analysis vs. Resume Preview) with an indigo bottom-border indicator for the active tab. The main body contains sections for 'Match Summary' with progress bars (1.5 height, gradient-filled), 'AI Optimization Suggestions' with an icon-list, and a 'Resume Preview' thumbnail area.

A fixed bottom bar in the right panel with padding: 24px and border-top (white/5%). Contains two equal-width buttons: a secondary button (bg-white/5, white text) and a primary 'AI' button (gradient-bg, indigo shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2)).

special_ui_components.description: A specialized list item component for job listings.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a card with padding: 24px, border-radius: 12px. It must include a job title (18px, Bold, white), company info (14px, gray-400), a match percentage badge (JetBrains Mono, indigo-400), and a 'publish time' footer. When 'isActive' is true, the border should be solid indigo-500/50 and the background should have a subtle indigo tint.

A white-background container with aspect ratio 1:1.4. Padding: 48px. Uses black (#1A1A1A) text. Header with bold uppercase name. Include an absolute-positioned hover overlay (bg-black/40) that reveals a 'Download PDF' button with a scale-up transition (hover:scale-105).

A container with height: 6px, background: white/10, border-radius: full. The progress fill must use the AI gradient (linear-gradient(135deg, #6366F1, #A855F7)) for 100% matches, or a solid yellow-400/80 for partial matches.

structured.special_notes: Must-dos: Maintain a consistent 1px border on all glass cards; use JetBrains Mono for matching percentages; ensure the resume preview (white background) has a significant drop shadow to pop against the dark UI. Must-nots: Avoid using pure white for text; use #E2E8F0 instead. Do not use rounded corners larger than 12px for cards to maintain a sharp, professional look.
